name: product-showcase
vibe: A commercial product-ad film shot on a lit studio stage. A near-black stage with a back-wall spotlight, a reflective floor, a glowing horizon line, a floor spotlight pool, drifting light beams and floating light dust flows unbroken across every cut. The hero product rises on a turntable inside a rim-lit device-frame with a soft reflection; feature callout leader-lines draw out to numbered labels; a light-burst climax blooms behind the product; a logo-reveal CTA closes. Everything is theme-driven, so the brand color repaints the whole studio — the stage glow, the spotlight pool, the rim light, the callout leaders, the gradient headlines and the CTA, not just the text. Portrait-native 9:16 for Reels, Shorts and TikTok. Rendered as a native GSAP + canvas composition. Best for product launches, app/SaaS showcases, e-commerce hero shots, screenshots and anything that should feel premium, cinematic and sales-ready.
